A.action: Twentieth weighted graph fixture with orbit-incidence accounting and two independent canonical-label algorithms.
A.acceptance: Exact enumeration, Burnside/direct orbit count, incidence row sums and both label algorithms agree; scaling remains null.

B.action: Schema v4→v5 migration with provenance-chain hashing and explicit downgrade controls.
B.acceptance: Exact chain/hash/version/path/value/default controls reject mutations and downgrade; provider evidence remains null.

C.action: Fourteen readers, ten replacement stages, journal checksums and interrupted-cleanup recovery.
C.acceptance: Readers observe complete bytes, stage/checksum/recovery traces bind, and injected failures cannot promote durability; crash/power-loss durability remains null.

D.action: ZIP64 Unicode-path CRC, descriptor signature and local/central normalization-parity corpus.
D.acceptance: Synthetic corpus validates exact CRC/signature/NFC parity and rejects name/CRC/signature/size/normalization mutations; real producer corpus remains open.

E.action: Twentieth issuer with two batch commits and receipt-cache epoch handoff.
E.acceptance: Event continuity, both commits, monotone watermarks, disjoint cache epochs and handoff binding pass; replay/ordering/epoch mutations reject; physical sample remains null.

F.action: Twenty-four components and six permutation parenthesizations with exact inverse proof.
F.acceptance: All parenthesizations and sequential interval/matrix paths agree, inverse recovery passes and binding mutations reject; commercial interpretation remains null.

G.action: Eleven transforms with exact determinant lemma and power-sum recurrence.
G.acceptance: Prior invariants plus determinant-lemma and recurrence identities pass over rationals; mutation rejects and calibration remains null.

H.action: Twenty-four scenarios with exact dynamic programming through leave-sixteen.
H.acceptance: Subset counts equal binomial coefficients, recurrence hashes bind and only finite illustrative intervals are reported; probability/capital claims remain null.

FND/EQN.action: Seventeen unit-tagged affine maps across five tree shapes and exact interval endpoints.
FND/EQN.acceptance: All tree shapes, endpoint propagation and inverse roundtrip agree; source/unit/order/nonmonotone controls reject; no new-law claim.

SCM.action: Thirteen observers, quorum eleven, minimum intersection nine and five chained transitions.
SCM.acceptance: Exact quorum-intersection/chain controls and inherited split/stale/fork/replay/downgrade controls pass; empirical coupling remains null.

AI-COST.action: Manifest v30 with frontier-proof reconstruction and independent full-root recomputation.
AI-COST.acceptance: Selected leaves plus frontier reconstruct the same root as all leaves and root/frontier/order/index/source/schema/config/metric mutations reject; equivalence remains null.

QOS/QSVT.action: Eighteen inverse pairs with exact schedule work, critical-path and slack certificates.
QOS/QSVT.acceptance: Full basis reconstruction, extension proof, work/critical path/slack recomputation and inherited proof/resource controls pass; hardware evidence remains null.

assumptions: All inputs are bounded fixtures or models.
Injected journal interruption and recovery do not establish crash or power-loss durability.
Custody hashes are synthetic fixtures, not signatures.
uncertainty: Provider authorization/billing, crash durability, archive interoperability, operational custody, measured covariance/calibration, owner priorities, independent derivation, real held-out equivalence and target-hardware evidence remain open.
nonclaims: No measured QPU/GPU performance, scaling or quantum advantage.
No provider execution/invoice, commercial economics or capital result.
No crash durability, cryptographic signature, calibration, physical sample, new physical law, AI equivalence or empirical SCM result.
